scenes.text: Your own VPN in ten minutes. No subscription, no VPN company in the middle.
All you need is a five-dollar server and a laptop.
Install Meridian with one line, then run meridian setup.
Paste your server's address. The defaults are sensible, so mostly you just press Enter.
Now the clever part: your server poses as a real website from its own network, so it looks like nothing special.
Meridian locks down the server, sets up the firewall and certificates, then tests every link.
Send each person their page. They scan the QR code, tap once, and they're connected.
Every server offers three methods. If one gets blocked, the app quietly switches.
Free and open source. The full walkthrough is on getmeridian.org.
